title: Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Tangy and dense Brazilian chicken skewers featuring salsa and deglaze-fond, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly dinner party, served on a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, soy sauce, and brown sugar.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
While the skewers are grilling, heat the salsa in a small saucepan over medium heat.
After the skewers have grilled for 8 minutes, brush them with the heated salsa.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
To make the deglaze-fond, pour the remaining marinade into the grill and scrape up the browned bits with a spatula.
Serve the skewers on a lazy-susan-spinner vessel, garnished with additional salsa and deglaze-fond if desired.
